templates.name: pedido_confirmado
templates.description: The order's charge was paid, told outside the 24-hour window: the customer ordered in the evening and paid the next day, and by then this is the only message WhatsApp will carry. {{1}} is the order's total as the code computed it.
templates.body: Oi! Recebemos o pagamento do seu pedido de {{1}}. Pedido confirmado, obrigado!

templates.name: pedido_confirmado
templates.description: The English copy of pedido_confirmado, sent when the conversation's locale is `en`. Same variables and the same buttons as the pt_BR copy; Meta approves each language separately.
templates.body: Hi! We received the payment for your order of {{1}}. Order confirmed, thank you!

templates.name: pedido_cobranca_vencida
templates.description: The order's charge reached its due date unpaid. It has to be its own template: a customer whose charge expired must not be told the order is confirmed. {{1}} is the order's total.
templates.body: Oi! A cobrança do seu pedido de {{1}} venceu sem pagamento. Se quiser, emito uma nova por aqui.

buttons.title: Emitir nova
buttons.intent: quero que voce emita uma nova cobranca para o meu pedido

buttons.title: Agora não
buttons.intent: agora nao quero uma nova cobranca para o meu pedido

templates.name: pedido_cobranca_vencida
templates.description: The English copy of pedido_cobranca_vencida, sent when the conversation's locale is `en`. Same variables and the same buttons as the pt_BR copy; Meta approves each language separately.
templates.body: Hi! The charge for your order of {{1}} reached its due date unpaid. If you like, I can issue a new one here.

buttons.title: Issue a new one
buttons.intent: I want you to issue a new charge for my order

buttons.title: Not now
buttons.intent: I do not want a new charge for my order right now

templates.name: pedido_cobranca_cancelada
templates.description: The order's charge was cancelled, so nothing was paid and nothing is owed on it. {{1}} is the order's total.
templates.body: Oi! A cobrança do seu pedido de {{1}} foi cancelada e nada foi pago. Qualquer coisa, é só falar por aqui.

templates.name: pedido_cobranca_cancelada
templates.description: The English copy of pedido_cobranca_cancelada, sent when the conversation's locale is `en`. Same variables and the same buttons as the pt_BR copy; Meta approves each language separately.
templates.body: Hi! The charge for your order of {{1}} was cancelled and nothing was paid. If you need anything, just write here.

templates.name: pedido_atualizacao
templates.description: The FALLBACK: sent by a poll, outside the 24-hour window, when an outcome closed that the agent has no template of its own for (a charge the rail failed to issue, a proposal denied or expired days later). It states NOTHING about the outcome, so it can never be the wrong news; it asks the person to answer, and an answer reopens the window, inside which the agent says what happened in free text. Takes no variables.
templates.body: Oi! Temos uma atualização sobre o seu atendimento. Responda esta mensagem para continuarmos por aqui.

buttons.title: Falar agora
buttons.intent: quero saber qual e a atualizacao do meu atendimento

templates.name: pedido_atualizacao
templates.description: The English copy of pedido_atualizacao, sent when the conversation's locale is `en`. Same variables and the same buttons as the pt_BR copy; Meta approves each language separately.
templates.body: Hi! We have an update about your request. Reply to this message so we can continue here.

buttons.title: Talk now
buttons.intent: I want to know what the update about my request is
